controls: HSE_STATUS_LIST_2026_2030_GATE
An installation is treated as an HSE during the 2026 to 2030 allocation period
Require inclusion in the published 2026 to 2030 HSE list before applying HSE-specific rules
Applying simplified HSE treatment to an unlisted installation
PASS
HSE_HOSPITAL_85_PERCENT_HEAT_GATE
The installation claims HSE status because it primarily serves hospitals
Require at least 85% of the heat produced in the scheme year to be used by or supplied to one or more hospitals
Classifying incidental hospital heat supply as primary hospital service
PASS
HSE_SMALL_EMITTER_DUAL_THRESHOLD
The installation claims HSE status as a small emitter rather than as a hospital service provider
Require annual emissions below 25,000 tCO2e and, where combustion applies, total rated thermal input below 35 MW
Using only one of the two eligibility thresholds
PASS
HSE_NO_ALLOWANCE_SURRENDER_BRANCH
An installation has valid HSE status for the scheme year
Do not create a main-scheme allowance-surrender obligation; assess compliance against its annual emissions target
Applying the wrong compliance mechanism
PASS
HSE_NO_FREE_ALLOCATION_BRANCH
An installation has valid HSE status
Do not assign free allocation while HSE status applies
Giving free allowances to an excluded HSE installation
PASS
HSE_ANNUAL_EMISSIONS_TARGET_REQUIRED
An installation is an HSE for a scheme year
Require an annual reportable-emissions target in the HSE permit
Leaving the HSE without a measurable compliance ceiling
PASS
HSE_TARGET_HISTORIC_EMISSIONS_REDUCTION_FACTOR
The regulator sets ordinary HSE targets using a complete historic baseline
Base targets on historic emissions multiplied by the applicable annual reduction factor
Using an unadjusted historical average
PASS
HSE_FORECAST_INITIAL_TARGET
The installation lacks a complete year of emissions data when HSE targets are first set
Use forecast emissions for the initial target and recalculate remaining-period targets when a full year becomes available
Treating an estimate as the permanent multi-year baseline
PASS
HSE_REPORTING_CALENDAR_YEAR_BOUNDARY
An HSE annual report is being prepared
Use 1 January through 31 December as the scheme-year monitoring period
Mixing allocation-period boundaries with annual reporting boundaries
PASS
HSE_ANNUAL_REPORT_31_MARCH
The HSE scheme year has ended
Submit the previous year's annual emissions report through METS by 31 March
Late annual reporting
PASS
HSE_DECLARATION_OR_VERIFICATION_BRANCH
An HSE chooses its annual assurance route
Require either satisfactory independent verification or an operator declaration accompanying the report
Accepting an unsupported annual emissions report
PASS
HSE_DECLARATION_THREE_ASSERTIONS
The HSE submits a declaration instead of a verification report
Require declarations of MRR compliance, monitoring-plan compliance and absence of material misstatements
Using an incomplete self-declaration
PASS
HSE_FORMAL_SUBMISSION_FINAL_METS_STEP
A verifier has returned the report or the operator has prepared its declaration
Do not mark the report formally submitted until the operator sends the report and assurance document to the regulator in METS
Confusing preparation or verifier return with regulatory submission
PASS
HSE_MISSING_REPORT_REGULATOR_DETERMINATION
No verified report or declaration-backed report is submitted by 31 March
Route to regulator determination, cost recovery and potential civil penalty
Treating a missing report as zero emissions
PASS
HSE_RISK_BASED_REGULATOR_AUDIT
An HSE uses the declaration route or is selected for compliance checking
Retain evidence and allow risk-based regulator audit, with higher-risk HSEs audited more often
Assuming self-declaration removes regulatory scrutiny
PASS
HSE_RECORDS_TEN_YEAR_RETENTION
Data or evidence supports an HSE annual emissions report
Retain relevant data and information for at least 10 years from report submission
Losing the audit trail before the regulator can review it
PASS
HSE_HOSPITAL_SERVICE_RECORDS
HSE status depends on primarily serving hospitals
Keep records demonstrating continued satisfaction of the hospital-service criterion
Failing to evidence continued 85% eligibility
PASS
HSE_SITE_VISIT_CATEGORY_A
A verifier assesses whether an HSE site visit may be waived
Treat the HSE as category A and require the verifier's written waiver justification in its records
Applying a stricter or unsupported site-visit category
PASS
HSE_SITE_VISIT_TRIGGER_CHANGE_OR_TWO_YEARS
An HSE changed verifier, had no site visit for the preceding two reporting years, or made a significant monitoring-plan modification
Require a verifier site visit unless a lawful waiver route applies
Skipping a mandatory site visit
PASS
HSE_PURCHASING_RECORDS_STOCK_ESTIMATE_ALLOWED
An HSE determines fuel or material activity data under simplified monitoring
Allow purchasing records and estimated stock changes where the approved plan supports them
Rejecting an expressly permitted simplified data method
PASS
HSE_TIER1_MINIMUM_WITH_ACCURACY_OVERRIDE
An HSE selects tiers for activity data, factors or measurement-based methods
Allow tier 1 as the minimum, but use greater accuracy where it is achievable without additional effort
Using simplification to block effortless accuracy improvements
PASS
HSE_NON_ACCREDITED_LAB_QA_GATE
An HSE uses a technically competent laboratory that lacks EN ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation
Require evidence of the laboratory's quality-assurance measures before accepting analytical factors
Accepting laboratory results without competence controls
PASS
HSE_RISK_PROCEDURE_REMAINS_REQUIRED
The HSE relies on exemptions from submitting uncertainty or risk-assessment documents
Still require maintained procedures that reduce the risk of errors in reports
Mistaking a submission exemption for removal of internal controls
PASS
HSE_YEAR_SPECIFIC_FACTOR_WHOLE_YEAR
An HSE uses published UK ETS default factors
Use the factors for the relevant scheme year and apply the same factor throughout that year
Mixing vintages or factors within one annual report
PASS
HSE_WHOLE_NUMBER_FINAL_EMISSIONS
The HSE calculates total annual reportable emissions
Retain sufficient precision in inputs and round only final annual emissions to a whole number
Premature rounding that changes the final emissions result
PASS
HSE_MONITORING_PLAN_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE_VARIATION
A proposed monitoring-plan change is significant
Apply to vary the permit through METS before relying on the change, subject to the stated timing rules
Treating a significant modification as an informal notification
PASS
HSE_NON_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE_31_DEC
A non-significant monitoring-plan change occurs
Notify the regulator through METS by 31 December of the year of change
Allowing minor changes to remain undisclosed
PASS
HSE_REPORT_BELOW_TARGET_BANKABLE
Verified or declared reportable emissions are below the annual HSE target
Calculate the bankable amount and use it to increase the next scheme year's target within the same allocation period
Discarding permitted overachievement
PASS
HSE_SMALL_EMITTER_BANK_CAP_24999
Banking would raise a small-emitter target above 24,999 tCO2e
Cap the increased target at 24,999 tCO2e
Using banking to cross the small-emitter ceiling
PASS
HSE_HOSPITAL_BANK_CAP_EXCEPTION
The HSE primarily provides services to a hospital
Do not apply the 24,999 tCO2e small-emitter banking cap solely on that basis
Applying the small-emitter cap to the hospital route
PASS
HSE_ESTIMATED_TARGET_ZERO_BANKING
The scheme-year target is based on estimated emissions
Set the bankable amount to zero
Banking against a forecast rather than measured historic performance
PASS
HSE_NO_CROSS_ALLOCATION_BANKING
An HSE has unused bankable amount at the end of an allocation period
Do not carry that amount into the next allocation period
Transferring overachievement across legally separate periods
PASS
HSE_EXCESS_TARGET_PENALTY_FORMULA
Reportable emissions exceed the HSE target
Calculate the excess-emissions amount as (reportable emissions minus target) multiplied by the scheme-year UK ETS carbon price
Using the full emissions total rather than only the excess
PASS
HSE_CAPACITY_INCREASE_APPLICATION_TIMING
An HSE seeks a higher target after putting a qualifying capacity increase into operation
Apply by the end of the scheme year or within three months of operation, whichever is later
Missing the time window for target adjustment
PASS
HSE_NO_VOLUNTARY_EXIT
An operator wants to leave HSE status during an allocation period without an eligibility-ending event
Reject voluntary cessation of HSE status during that allocation period
Switching compliance regimes opportunistically
PASS
HSE_THRESHOLD_OR_HOSPITAL_LOSS_NOTIFY_31_MARCH
Hospital-service eligibility ends or a small emitter exceeds 24,999 tCO2e in a scheme year
Notify the regulator by 31 March of the following scheme year
Delaying status-transition notice
PASS
HSE_CONVERSION_NEXT_SCHEME_YEAR
The regulator issues a conversion notice ending HSE status
Apply GHGE permit conditions from 1 January of the following scheme year and vary the monitoring plan accordingly
Changing regimes in the wrong year
PASS
USE_STATUS_LIST_2026_2030_GATE
An installation is treated as a USE in the 2026 to 2030 allocation period
Require inclusion in the published 2026 to 2030 USE list
Applying USE treatment to an unlisted installation
PASS
USE_2499_ELIGIBILITY_BASELINE_GATE
USE eligibility for 2026 to 2030 is assessed from available baseline years
Require reportable emissions of 2,499 tCO2e or below in every applicable baseline year for the installation's start-date cohort
Treating a single low year as sufficient
PASS
USE_MONITORING_PLAN_MAINTAINED
An installation has USE status
Continue monitoring under an up-to-date, fit-for-purpose monitoring plan
Assuming USE status removes monitoring duties
PASS
USE_THRESHOLD_BREACH_NOTIFICATION
A USE emits more than 2,500 tCO2e in a scheme year
Notify the regulator and trigger the applicable status-transition process
Keeping USE treatment after the agreed threshold is exceeded
PASS
USE_NO_VOLUNTARY_EXIT
A USE seeks to leave status voluntarily during an allocation period
Reject voluntary cessation during the allocation period
Opportunistic movement between compliance regimes
PASS
USE_AIRCRAFT_OPERATOR_INELIGIBLE
The applicant is an aircraft operator
Do not register it as a USE; apply the separate low-emissions aviation rules
Applying installation-only USE status to aviation
PASS
USE_NO_PERMIT_BUT_CONTINUED_MONITORING
An installation has valid USE status
Do not require an HSE or GHGE permit solely for that status, but continue emissions monitoring and threshold notification
Equating permit exemption with absence of compliance duties
PASS
